title: SECTION I — WHEN DREAMS MERGE
summary: The opening section builds the collection’s largest philosophical frame. Its long poems move through time, history, mortality, knowledge, liberation, plurality and the relation between inward freedom and public responsibility. Recurrent images of rivers, sky, light, doors and mirrors ask how changing experience can be taken seriously without being mistaken for the whole of reality.
